<style>
/* Instant Quote — behavior-only CSS (page head)
 * Layout, grids, borders, typography → Webflow Designer classes only.
 */

:root {
  --iq-bg: #00001c;
  --iq-border: #ffffff;
  --iq-tick-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
  --iq-tick-mark: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
  --iq-glow-blue: #3b82f6;
  --iq-glow-navy: #1e3a8a;
}

/* ── V2: viewport strategy (no height:100vh + overflow:hidden lock) ── */

.iq-page {
  min-height: 90vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
}

.iq-container {
  width: 100%;
}

/* ── V2: intro above quality toggle ─────────────────────────────────── */

.iq-intro {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto 8px;
  padding: 0 12px;
}

.iq-intro-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(22px, 3.2vw, 34px);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--iq-border);
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.iq-intro-lead {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 560px;
  font-size: clamp(14px, 1.6vw, 17px);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
}

/* ── V2: total cost gradient border + radial glow ───────────────────── */

.iq-total-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  border: 0 !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(var(--iq-bg), var(--iq-bg)) padding-box,
    linear-gradient(135deg, var(--iq-glow-blue), var(--iq-glow-navy)) border-box;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  border-radius: 14px;
}

.iq-total-wrapper::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 18% 12% 8%;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15) 0%,
    transparent 70%
  );
}

.iq-total-wrapper > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

#iq-total-price,
.iq-total-price {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* ── V2: Calculate Production Run ───────────────────────────────────── */

.iq-run-quote-wrap {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 18px;
}

#iq-run-quote,
.iq-run-quote {
  appearance: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: min(100%, 360px);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--iq-glow-blue), var(--iq-glow-navy));
  color: #ffffff;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 14px 28px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: filter 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(59, 130, 246, 0);
}

#iq-run-quote:hover,
#iq-run-quote:focus-visible,
.iq-run-quote:hover,
.iq-run-quote:focus-visible {
  filter: brightness(1.08);
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.35);
}

#iq-run-quote.is-running,
.iq-run-quote.is-running {
  transform: scale(0.98);
}

/* ── Slider embeds (HtmlEmbed) ───────────────────────────────────────── */

.iq-slider-control {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 56px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 0 11px;
}

.iq-slider-ticks {
  position: absolute;
  left: 11px;
  right: 11px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  height: 12px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.iq-slider-track-line {
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  top: 50%;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--iq-tick-line);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  z-index: 0;
}

.iq-slider-tick {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: 1px;
  height: 8px;
  background: var(--iq-tick-mark);
  flex: 0 0 1px;
}

.iq-range {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  height: 56px;
  margin: 0;
  background: transparent;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.iq-range:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.iq-range:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.iq-range:focus-visible::-moz-range-thumb {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

.iq-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
  height: 1px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.iq-range::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  width: 22px;
  height: 44px;
  margin-top: -21px;
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--iq-border);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  transition: transform 0.12s ease;
}

.iq-range:active::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  transform: scaleY(1.04);
}

.iq-range::-moz-range-track {
  height: 1px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
}

.iq-range::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 22px;
  height: 44px;
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--iq-border);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}

.iq-range::-moz-range-progress {
  background: transparent;
}

.iq-toggle-track .iq-toggle-btn {
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-wrap: nowrap;
}

/* ── Custom check / radio appearance ───────────────────────────────── */

.iq-check {
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  min-width: 22px;
  min-height: 22px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 2px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  transition: background 0.15s ease;
}

.iq-style-option .iq-check {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  min-width: 20px;
  min-height: 20px;
}

.iq-check:checked {
  background: var(--iq-border);
}

.iq-check:checked::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 5px;
  height: 9px;
  border: solid var(--iq-bg);
  border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
  transform: translate(-50%, -58%) rotate(45deg);
}

/* ── 50/50 split row + unit cost #2 reveal (JS toggles .is-visible) ─── */

#split-row-wrapper {
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-10px);
  transition:
    max-height 0.48s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.36s ease,
    transform 0.36s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
  visibility: hidden;
}

#split-row-wrapper.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
  visibility: visible;
}

#iq-unit-cost-2 {
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-8px);
  transition:
    max-height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    transform 0.3s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
  visibility: hidden;
}

#iq-unit-cost-2.is-visible {
  max-height: 120px;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
  visibility: visible;
}

/* ── Art pricing modal (footer HTML) ───────────────────────────────── */

.iq-modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease, visibility 0.25s ease;
}

.iq-modal.is-open {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.iq-modal-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 28, 0.78);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
}

.iq-modal-panel {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  width: min(560px, 100%);
  max-height: min(80vh, 640px);
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--iq-bg);
  padding: 28px 28px 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}

.iq-modal-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  appearance: none;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--iq-border);
  font-size: 28px;
  line-height: 1;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.iq-modal-title {
  margin: 0 32px 16px 0;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.iq-modal-body p {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.iq-modal-body p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ── JS-driven form states only ────────────────────────────────────── */

.iq-form-status.is-success {
  color: #6ee7b7;
}

.iq-form-status.is-error {
  color: #fca5a5;
}

.iq-form-upload.is-dragover {
  border-color: #2aaab8;
  background: rgba(42, 170, 184, 0.08);
}

/* ── Order form — 2×2 contact grid (native Webflow FormForm) ─────────── */

#iq-order-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  column-gap: 24px;
  row-gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
}

#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; margin-bottom: 12px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; margin-bottom: 12px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(5) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(6) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 4; margin-bottom: 12px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(7) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(8) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 4; margin-bottom: 12px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(9) { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 5; margin-top: 8px; }
#iq-order-form > *:nth-child(10) { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 6; margin-bottom: 16px; }

/* Hide legacy Webflow file upload (art upload lives above) */
#iq-form-artwork-file-legacy {
  display: none !important;
}

#iq-order-form > #iq-form-submit,
#iq-order-form > .iq-form-submit {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  grid-row: 7;
  margin-top: 16px;
  display: flex !important;
  width: 100%;
}

#iq-order-form .w-form-label,
#iq-order-form label {
  display: block;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

#iq-order-form .w-input,
#iq-order-form input[type='text'],
#iq-order-form input[type='email'],
#iq-order-form input[type='tel'],
#iq-order-form textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--iq-border);
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

#iq-order-form textarea {
  min-height: 132px;
  resize: vertical;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

#iq-order-form .w-input:focus,
#iq-order-form textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(42, 170, 184, 0.45);
}

#iq-form-submit {
  appearance: none;
  display: flex;
  width: 100%;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: #2aaab8;
  color: #ffffff;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  padding: 16px 24px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: filter 0.2s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
}

#iq-form-submit:hover,
#iq-form-submit:focus-visible {
  filter: brightness(1.08);
  outline: none;
}

#iq-form-submit:disabled {
  opacity: 0.55;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* ── Unit price cards — full white border ────────────────────────────── */

#iq-unit-cost-1,
#iq-unit-cost-2 {
  border: 1px solid var(--iq-border);
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* ── Artwork upload (basic) ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

#iq-artwork-info-trigger {
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

#iq-artwork-info-trigger:hover,
#iq-artwork-info-trigger:focus-visible {
  opacity: 0.85;
  outline: none;
}

.iq-form-upload-input {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px !important;
  height: 1px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: -1px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
  border: 0 !important;
}

.iq-form-upload-list[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 991px) {
  #iq-order-form,
  #iq-order-form > *:nth-child(n) {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-row: auto;
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }
}
</style>

context: Deploy Instant Quote V2 head CSS including viewport, glow, and Run Quote styles.
